heard_on_the_hill.headline: Mast issues statement on outbound investment curbs
heard_on_the_hill.body: House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Mast issued a statement on outbound investment restrictions on October 23. The Treasury Department proposed a rule on Thursday restricting U.S. investment in Chinese artificial intelligence, hypersonic weapons and biotechnology, the AP reported, and MOFCOM said it "firmly opposes" the proposal.

heard_on_the_hill.headline: Rep. Biggs introduces Stop Beijing's Bots Act
heard_on_the_hill.body: Rep. Sheri Biggs (R-SC) introduced H.R. 10860, the Stop Beijing's Bots Act, on October 22.

heard_on_the_hill.headline: Select Committee cites Webull messages on China access
heard_on_the_hill.body: The House Select Committee on the CCP said internal 2021 Webull messages indicate an employee believed to be based in China had access to information about a U.S. customer account, CNBC reported. Webull says sensitive U.S. customer data is restricted to U.S.-based employees.

heard_on_the_hill.headline: Congress-appointed official faults patrols east of Taiwan
heard_on_the_hill.body: A U.S. Congress-appointed official said Chinese naval and coast guard patrols to Taiwan's east are destabilising regional security, Reuters reported. Separately, USCC Chair Randall Schriver warned China is using coast guard vessels to advance territorial claims around Taiwan, per Taiwan News.

research.title: Not Just an Island: Why Geography Should Not Drive U.S. Taiwan Policy
research.line: Argues U.S. Taiwan policy should center on preventing a PRC attack and its catastrophe, not Taiwan's place in the first island chain.
